body.heading: Where in the world is Belize?
paragraphs: Belize is a country in Central America, which is part of North America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Belize is Belmopan.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Belize speak English and Spanish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Belize is the Belize dollar.

body.heading: How big is Belize?
paragraphs: Belize covers about 23,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Dominican Republic.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Belize's reef is the largest in the northern hemisphere. Families snorkel at Hol Chan and Shark Ray Alley, and gaze into the perfect circle of the Great Blue Hole.
Inland, the Maya pyramid of Xunantunich rises above the jungle — reached by a hand-cranked ferry — near cave tubing rivers and butterfly farms.

body.heading: Think and talk

2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
